# David Kozdra

> Software engineer building APIs, cloud systems, web applications, and LLM evaluation tooling. This website contains a professional portfolio, resume, project case studies, and interactive browser experiments.

The home page is DK OS, an interactive desktop-style portfolio. The following static HTML pages provide the professional content without requiring JavaScript.

## Professional background

- [Resume](https://davidkozdra.com/resume/): Experience, skills, education, certifications, and contact information.
- [Work and case studies](https://davidkozdra.com/work/): Selected software projects, engineering contributions, and outcomes.
- [AI and LLM evaluation](https://davidkozdra.com/ai-evals/): MCP testing infrastructure, automated QA, prompt systems, scoring, and retrieval-augmented generation.
- [About](https://davidkozdra.com/pages/about/): Work experience, open-source contributions, and certifications.
- [Project explorer](https://davidkozdra.com/pages/projects/): Project guide and interactive filters for web apps, developer tools, and games.

## Selected case studies

- [RedChat](https://davidkozdra.com/work/redchat/): An AI SEC-filing summarizer using document preparation and retrieval.
- [Stock portal](https://davidkozdra.com/work/stock-portal/): Python data aggregation, market information, and structured SEC-filing views.
- [Promo](https://davidkozdra.com/work/promo-app/): Backend APIs and mobile features for an event-based social app.
- [GitPulse](https://davidkozdra.com/work/gitpulse/): A Chrome extension for assessing GitHub repository activity.
- [GitPulse privacy policy](https://davidkozdra.com/gitPulsePrivacyPolicy.html): Data handling and privacy information for the extension.
